sources.title: Mechanical Seals for Pumps
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 工業泵浦效率測試
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：功率單位為W，兩法一致，密封完整性與熱量估算分開判斷。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Power uses W, both methods agree, and seal integrity is assessed separately from heat estimation.
related.difference: 建立流量、揚程、軸功率與電力的量測邊界，避免算出超過100%的假效率。
related.differenceEn: Define flow, head, shaft and electrical measurement boundaries to prevent spurious efficiencies above 100%.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 平均半徑近似下 v=2πrn/60，摩擦功率Q=μFv；真實密封存在液膜與非均勻接觸。 純教學r=0.025 m、n=600 rpm、合成接觸力100 N、摩擦係數0.05。 v=1.5708 m/s；Q=0.05×100×1.5708=7.854 W。這不是任何密封操作規格。
水力功率ρgQH；泵效率除軸功率，泵組效率除電力，兩者分母不同。 合成水ρ1000 kg/m³，Q0.020 m³/s，H20 m，軸功率5.0 kW，電力5.5 kW。 Ph=1000×9.81×0.020×20=3924 W；泵η78.48%，泵組η71.345%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At mean radius v=2 π rn/60 and friction power Q=μ Fv; real seals include films and nonuniform contact. Teaching r 0.025 m, n 600 rpm, synthetic face force 100 N and friction coefficient 0.05. v=1.5708 m/s; Q=7.854 W, not a seal operating specification.

Hydraulic power is ρ gQH; pump efficiency divides by shaft power, pump-set efficiency by electrical input. Synthetic water ρ1000 kg/m³, Q 0.020 m³/s, H 20 m, shaft 5.0 kW, electrical 5.5 kW. Ph=3924 W; pump η78.48%, pump-set η71.345%.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機器人末端夾具設計
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：功率單位為W，兩法一致，密封完整性與熱量估算分開判斷。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Power uses W, both methods agree, and seal integrity is assessed separately from heat estimation.
related.difference: 畫出兩接觸點受力，明確區分每爪法向力與總夾持力。
related.differenceEn: Draw both contacts and distinguish per-jaw normal force from total gripping force.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 平均半徑近似下 v=2πrn/60，摩擦功率Q=μFv；真實密封存在液膜與非均勻接觸。 純教學r=0.025 m、n=600 rpm、合成接觸力100 N、摩擦係數0.05。 v=1.5708 m/s；Q=0.05×100×1.5708=7.854 W。這不是任何密封操作規格。
垂直靜態搬運簡化為2μN≥Smg，N是每爪法向力；動態、接觸壓力與力矩另驗。 教學質量1 kg、μ=0.30、比較係數S=2、g=9.81 m/s²。 每爪N≥2×1×9.81/(2×0.30)=32.7 N；兩爪法向力總和65.4 N。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: At mean radius v=2 π rn/60 and friction power Q=μ Fv; real seals include films and nonuniform contact. Teaching r 0.025 m, n 600 rpm, synthetic face force 100 N and friction coefficient 0.05. v=1.5708 m/s; Q=7.854 W, not a seal operating specification.

A simplified vertical static grasp requires 2 μN≥Smg, with N per jaw; dynamics, pressure and moments need separate checks. Teaching mass 1 kg,μ0.30, comparison factor S 2, g 9.81 m/s². Each jaw needsN≥32.7 N; the sum of normal forces is 65.4 N.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
